title: SaaS landing page
palette_note: Near-white base with a pale ice-blue hero bloom; a single electric-blue ramp (#3C54FC to #3CC0FC) fills the CTA, the hero stat tile and the open FAQ row, and the page closes on a full-black band.

type.note: Bold ~56px geometric display headline with wide round bowls and a distinctive long hyphen in 'real-time'; drops straight to 15px regular grey body with no intermediate scale. Bold inline emphasis is used mid-sentence in body copy. Nav and micro-labels stay small and medium-weight.

imagery: product screenshots (embedded dashboard UI, repeated as cropped feature cards) plus one stock office photograph and a monochrome logo wall

layout.note: Centred hero over a soft radial wash, then a strict alternating rhythm: logo strip, 50/50 image-text split, three-up feature cards. Cards are white on white separated only by hairlines and micro-shadow; whitespace is generous but never theatrical.

style_signature: Near-white page with a pale ice-blue radial hero wash, one electric-blue gradient reserved for CTAs and the single hero stat tile, bold geometric-sans headlines over small grey body, and a hard cut to a full-black closing band.

title: PrimeStay - SaaS Landing Page
palette_note: Cool light base with a blue-to-white radial bloom behind the hero; one royal blue does double duty as pill-CTA fill and as a full-bleed deep-navy-to-blue gradient pricing section, with a near-black footer beneath.

type.note: The signature move is a two-family headline: geometric sans set against a high-contrast italic didone serif for the second word ('Management', 'Your Plan', 'Asked Questions'). Body is 15px regular grey; feature headings use Title Case; tiny pill chips carry sentence-case micro-labels.

imagery: product screenshots (dashboard with donut and line charts) plus framed lifestyle photography and a monochrome logo wall

layout.note: Floating pill nav bar inset from the top edge; centred hero with a two-button CTA pair; the dashboard screenshot enters bottom-third and bleeds off. Pricing switches to dark-on-blue cards. Feature lists use a left vertical rule rather than boxes.

style_signature: Royal-blue SaaS marketing page whose whole personality comes from splicing a high-contrast italic serif into geometric-sans headlines, with pill nav and buttons and a full-bleed navy-to-blue gradient pricing block.

title: Task Management Saas Web App - Kanban Board Task Lists
palette_note: Essentially white-and-grey; a single violet carries the primary button and the active tab underline, and every remaining hue arrives only as a small semantic chip (amber, pink, green, periwinkle) never larger than a word.

type.note: Inter-like UI grotesque throughout. Oversized ~44px page title drops straight to 15px body with no display tier between. Card titles semibold, metadata regular grey; no tracking manipulation and no caps anywhere.

imagery: iconography only (thin outline icons) plus small round avatar photos

layout.note: Full-bleed browser view with no device frame or drop-shadowed window. Three grey column wells hold white cards; each card is a strict four-row stack (chip, title, description, meta) closed by a hairline rule above the comment/link counters. Alignment is rigidly gridded and the composition is deliberately low-energy.

style_signature: Full-bleed white-and-grey productivity UI where one violet owns the only filled button and colour otherwise exists only inside word-sized status chips, with grey column wells holding hairline-ruled white cards.

title: Documents Split View - SAAS
palette_note: Pale lavender-white ground, deep navy for all type and top chrome, and one fully saturated indigo carrying the logo, active nav pill, selection ring and the oversized diagonal background wedges — no third hue except the crimson figures inside the invoice preview.

type.note: Chunky bold navy headings with softly rounded terminals sit over thin light-grey secondary lines; filenames are bold, author and timestamp metadata drop to a much lighter weight and smaller size. The weight gap between the two is the whole hierarchy.

imagery: document thumbnails and outline iconography; no photography beyond tiny avatars

layout.note: A single large rounded app window floats on the page with a wide soft shadow, and huge indigo diagonal wedges bleed off opposite corners behind it. Inside, three panes (nav, file list, preview) are separated by whitespace and elevation rather than rules; the preview card lifts above everything on a heavy shadow.

style_signature: Floating rounded app window on pale lavender with oversized indigo diagonal wedges bleeding off-corner behind it, deep-navy rounded-humanist headings, and separation carried entirely by soft shadow instead of borders.

title: Zingflow / AI SaaS UX/UI Details - Workspace
artifact_type: design tool UI (workspace panel shown in two variants)
palette_note: Cool near-neutral grey-blue field with pure-white panels; a single acid chartreuse fills only the primary button, and all other colour is strictly functional (amber progress bar, green trendline and savings, violet vendor chip) at chip scale.

type.note: Compact Inter-like UI face held at 13-15px almost everywhere; only the best-offer price steps up. Numerals are tabular and hard right-aligned against left-aligned labels, so every row reads as a key/value strip.

imagery: iconography plus inline data viz — a bar chart in one variant, a filled area chart in the other; no photography

layout.note: Single-column stacked panel divided into labelled sections by full-width hairlines; inside each section, grey-filled key/value rows tile with tight gutters. Two near-identical variants are set side by side for A/B comparison, which is itself the composition.

style_signature: Achromatic grey-and-white key/value panel built from hairline-divided sections and tabular right-aligned numerals, with exactly one acid-chartreuse button as the only saturated mark on screen.

title: Picktime - Smart Meetings Platform SAAS
palette_note: Desaturated periwinkle-and-white field; the brand indigo is deliberately muted rather than fully saturated, and pastel peach, mint and lavender gradient tints are used to differentiate feature and pricing cards.

type.note: Large friendly geometric display (~64px, single-storey a, wide circular bowls) set semibold rather than black, over 16px grey body. Section headings repeat the same face at the same weight, so scale alone carries hierarchy.

imagery: pseudo-3D floating icon tiles and tilted overlapping UI cards, plus flat product screenshots; no photography beyond tiny avatars

layout.note: Centred hero with dotted connector lines radiating out to orbiting rounded-square icon tiles, and three overlapping tilted screenshot cards stacked at the centre to fake depth. Below, pastel-tinted feature cards sit two-up with lots of air.

style_signature: Pale periwinkle hero with dotted connector lines radiating to soft-shadowed floating icon tiles, overlapping tilted UI cards for depth, and muted-indigo buttons on pastel peach/mint/lavender gradient cards.

title: Ecomiq: Campaign Creation for SaaS eCommerce
palette_note: White modal over a heavily dimmed grey scrim; a hot orange owns the step badge and the single primary button, while a separate violet is reserved exclusively as the AI affordance colour on 'Generate' and its sparkle glyph.

type.note: Inter-like face; 24px semibold dialog title, 16px field labels in medium, 15px body regular. Generated-result blocks prefix their copy with a grey metadata line (character count, word count, tone) in the same size as the body, distinguished only by colour.

imagery: one full-bleed product photograph inside the simulated social ad preview; otherwise iconography and a single emoji-style megaphone

layout.note: Two-pane modal: white form left, grey preview rail right, split by a hairline running the full height. A numbered 1-2-3 stepper with connecting rules sits under the title, and the footer is a sticky bar with text-link Cancel left of the filled primary right.

style_signature: Neutral grey-and-white two-pane modal over a dimmed scrim, with a numbered connector stepper, one hot-orange primary button, and a second violet used only to mark AI-generated affordances.

title: Ecomiq — Product Listing Dashboard for SaaS E-commerce
palette_note: Almost entirely white and neutral grey; hot orange appears exactly twice (sidebar add button, 'Add Product'), a black pill marks the one applied filter, and green is confined to 'Active' status chips and stock rings.

type.note: Inter-like face at 14-15px throughout with a 24px semibold page title; the only caps is a tiny tracked 'WORKSPACE' section label in the sidebar. Product variant rows use tabular figures so prices and quantities align into implicit columns.

imagery: small square product thumbnails (cut-out product photography) plus thin outline iconography

layout.note: The whole app sits as a rounded window with a wide soft shadow on a flat light-grey board. Inside: icon rail, text sidebar, then a three-up card grid where each card is a mini table of variants closed by a status-chip footer. Filters read as a horizontal pill row above the grid.

style_signature: Rounded app window floating on flat light grey, near-monochrome inside, with product cards that behave like miniature data tables and exactly two hot-orange buttons as the only saturated marks.

title: Documents Grid View - SAAS
palette_note: Same system as the split view: lavender-white ground, deep navy chrome and type, one saturated indigo for logo, active nav pill and the thick selection ring — with document tiles softly tinted by category (blue, mint, lilac, cream).

type.note: Bold navy headings with rounded terminals against thin light-grey metadata; the 'Documents' title is set very heavy and large relative to everything under it, and category tags shrink to a small medium-weight pill.

imagery: document thumbnails rendered as greyed micro-layouts; iconography and small avatars, no photography

layout.note: The rounded app window floats over a hugely enlarged, heavily blurred duplicate of its own content — the depth-of-field backdrop is the composition. Inside, a four-column tile grid where the selected tile is ringed in thick indigo and lifted forward.

style_signature: The same indigo-and-navy document UI staged over a massively scaled, blurred copy of itself, with tinted document tiles and a thick indigo selection ring pulling one tile above the plane.

title: Bloggo — Dashboard for SaaS AI Blog Automation Platform
palette_note: White app on a flat grey board with one periwinkle-violet primary; status is carried by a full pastel chip set (lilac 'Being Edited', pink 'Waiting Review', amber 'Revision', mint 'Approved') that also tints each article card's top edge.

type.note: Bold ~32px greeting headline with an emoji set inline, then 16px regular body with an underlined inline stat ('30 hours') as emphasis. Sidebar section labels are tiny tracked caps; article titles are semibold and wrap to two lines.

imagery: illustration — multicolour filled-outline icons and a flat abstract UI illustration in the onboarding banner — plus greyed article thumbnails

layout.note: Rounded app window with a wide soft shadow on flat grey. A numbered onboarding checklist sits half-in a grey panel beside an illustrated promo, then a three-up quick-action row, then a three-column article grid whose cards are headed by a coloured status chip on a tinted strip.

style_signature: White dashboard floating on flat grey, one periwinkle-violet primary, and a pastel status-chip system that colours the top strip of every content card so state is readable from the grid alone.

title: Schedulo — Notification Drawer in SaaS Booking Management
palette_note: White-on-warm-grey with a cyan-teal brand accent that also drives a sequential heatmap ramp for the busy-times chart; red is strictly alarm state (unread dots, 'Overload' bar) and magenta marks appointment status pills.

type.note: Inter-like face; big semibold KPI numerals (~40px) against 14px labels, and notification rows use bold runs inside otherwise-regular sentences to surface the service name, date and time. Sidebar group labels are small tracked caps.

imagery: iconography only — square outline glyphs in tinted circles — plus one product thumbnail in the low-stock row

layout.note: Rounded app window on a flat warm-grey board. An opaque white drawer slides over the left third and simply occludes the dashboard behind it — no dimming, no blur — with a small collapse chevron straddling its edge. Content beneath is a two-column KPI and chart grid.

style_signature: Flat-grey-boarded app window where an opaque white drawer overlays a third of the UI without dimming it, cyan drives both accent and heatmap ramp, and bold text runs inside plain sentences do the work of a data table.

title: Saas - Website Design
artifact_type: marketing landing page with embedded app UI
palette_note: A pale blue cloud gradient occupies the entire hero with near-black type sitting straight on it; the only high-chroma marks are the blue CTA pill and two isolated brand-icon tiles (magenta, green) floating loose in the whitespace.

type.note: Very large, tightly tracked display headline (~90px, Helvetica-Now-ish) dominating the hero, dropping hard to 16px light-grey body. The embedded app below reuses the same face at 13-14px, so the whole shot reads as one family at wildly different scales.

imagery: abstract gradients as the primary visual, plus an embedded product screenshot and free-floating brand-icon tiles

layout.note: Faint square grid ruled over the gradient hero; floating pill nav inset from the top; oversized centred headline with the CTA pill directly beneath. The product UI enters the bottom third as a rounded panel bleeding off-frame, and its kanban columns are separated by dashed rules rather than fills.

style_signature: Pale blue cloud-gradient hero under a faint ruled grid, one enormous tightly-tracked black headline, a glowing blue pill CTA, and loose brand-colour icon tiles floating as the only chroma before the product panel bleeds in from below.

title: AI SaaS Landing Page Design
artifact_type: marketing landing page (AI workflow SaaS), presented as tiled page panels
palette_note: Warm off-white pages on a cool grey board, true black for the stat and CTA bands, and one acid chartreuse behaving like a highlighter — on partial numerals, a text underline, chips, sparkline and the single primary button.

type.note: Tight geometric-grotesque display at ~72px with noticeably negative tracking, against small tracked ALL-CAPS micro-labels ('TRUSTED BY 12,000+ TEAMS', 'TASKS AUTOMATED', 'ACTIVE FLOWS'). The caps labels are the connective tissue of the entire page.

imagery: product screenshots as floating dashboard cards with detached stat tooltips, plus one thin-line orbit diagram and a single small testimonial portrait

layout.note: The page itself is presented as large rounded panels tiled on a grey board. Inside, a bento of white cards alternates with full-black bands; the hero dashboard is composed from a main card plus two small tooltip cards escaping its bounds, and the black CTA carries a soft green radial glow.

style_signature: Warm-white bento panels on grey cut by full-black bands with a green radial glow, tight negative-tracked geometric display type, tracked all-caps micro-labels, and acid chartreuse used as a highlighter on numerals and underlines rather than as a fill.

title: AI SaaS Landing Page - Web Design Concept
artifact_type: marketing landing page concept (desktop + mobile artboards)
palette_note: Silver-grey board and near-white page with deep navy type; every bit of chroma comes from a blurred pearlescent tile mosaic ramping sky-blue to lilac to magenta to peach, and it is never used as a flat fill anywhere.

type.note: One weight across a huge headline; hierarchy is created by colour alternation within a single sentence — 'Your' and 'engine.' in deep navy, 'next-level productivity' in pale slate — and a live toggle-switch glyph is set inline in the text line as if it were a word.

imagery: abstract gradients only — a mosaic of blurred rounded-square tiles; no photography or illustration

layout.note: Desktop and mobile artboards overlapped on a plain grey board with soft shadows. The hero is mostly empty air with the tile mosaic rising from the bottom edge; faint vertical rules hint at a column grid. The CTA is a dark pill with a pronounced bevel and hard drop shadow, reading almost physical against the flat page.

style_signature: Silver page with a mosaic of blurred pearlescent rounded-square tiles rising from the bottom edge, a single-weight headline split into navy and pale-slate words, an inline toggle glyph used as typography, and a bevelled dark pill CTA.

title: Choose Word Count Modal for saas web app dashboard
palette_note: White dialog on a heavily blurred grey backdrop; one emerald green marks selection everywhere it appears (card ring, radio, primary button) while a pale lilac tint carries the 'Recommended' badge and the advisory strip.

type.note: Bold ~32px dialog title over 16px regular body at a comfortably wide measure; option titles semibold, supporting copy regular grey. No caps, no tracking tricks — the field label 'Enter Word Count:' even keeps its colon, which gives the dialog a plain-spoken, form-like voice.

imagery: 3D renders — two glossy squircle app-icon illustrations with bevelled edges and inner shadow; no photography

layout.note: A single centred dialog dominating the frame, with the underlying dashboard blurred almost to abstraction. Two stacked full-width selectable cards, the active one ringed green and tinted; footer is a hairline-topped bar with a ghost Cancel left and the filled primary right.

style_signature: Centred white dialog over a near-abstract blurred dashboard, full-width selectable cards where the chosen one is ringed and tinted in emerald, glossy 3D squircle icons per option, and a lilac 'Recommended' badge as the only competing hue.
